notes.title: Cartastrophe Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
 - Added 2 new maps, Cart City and The Factory
 - You can now continue working on previously saved maps
 - Added simple Undo commands in the Map Editor
 - Internal Player Physics Changes
 - Player no longer floats down while falling
 - Music volume now defaults to 1 when its your first time playing the game.
 - Fixed outdated music in Cart Tower
 - Fixed Next Level button in Cart Tower

Looking forward to some more updates for Cartastrophe soon, back on the grind now i guess.
